# LocalPDF

> Free, open-source, 100% client-side PDF toolkit running entirely inside the user's browser via WebAssembly and JavaScript. Zero file uploads, zero accounts, offline-capable PWA with OS File Handling API, Strict Air-Gapped Mode, 29 standalone PDF tools, and visual Multi-Step PDF Recipes.

Website: https://www.uselocalpdf.com
Source: https://github.com/Tuyishimire-lab/Localpdf
Full LLM Reference: https://www.uselocalpdf.com/llms-full.txt

## Core Differentiators

- [PDF Recipes & Multi-Step Pipelines](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/recipes): Chain and save reusable local workflows such as Merge -> Bates Numbering -> Watermark -> Metadata Scrub -> Lossless Compress -> 256-bit AES Protect.
- [Security & Transparency](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/security): Provable zero-upload WebAssembly architecture, DevTools Network audit guide, and Strict Air-Gapped Mode toggle.
- [Compare Alternatives](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/compare): Side-by-side privacy, offline, and feature comparisons against cloud PDF tools.
- [PDF Guides & Blog](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/blog): Step-by-step privacy and PDF workflow tutorials.

## All 29 Local PDF Tools

### Organize & Page Management
- [Organize PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/organize): Reorder, delete, duplicate, rotate, and insert blank pages visually.
- [Merge PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/merge): Combine multiple PDFs into a single file in custom order.
- [Split PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/split): Extract page ranges or split every page into separate files.
- [Split by Size / Bookmarks](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/split-by-size): Split large PDFs by target MB limit or top-level bookmark outline chapters.
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/rotate): Rotate individual pages or entire documents.
- [Crop PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/crop): Trim margins losslessly via rotation-aware PDF CropBox bounds.
- [Repair PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/repair): Rebuild damaged cross-reference tables and recover PDFs via QPDF WebAssembly.

### Convert & Extract
- [PDF to Word](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert PDFs into editable `.docx` documents with two-column layout preservation.
- [Word / TXT to PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/word-to-pdf): Convert `.docx`, `.txt`, and `.md` files to PDF client-side.
- [PDF to Excel / CSV](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/pdf-to-excel): Extract structured tabular data into `.xlsx` workbooks or `.csv` files locally.
- [PDF to JPG / PNG](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Render PDF pages to high-resolution JPG, PNG, or ZIP archives.
- [JPG to PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Combine JPG, PNG, and WebP images into formatted PDFs.
- [Extract Images](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/extract-images): Pull embedded photos and raster graphics from PDFs as lossless PNGs or ZIP.

### Edit, Optimize & Forms
- [Compress PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/compress): Reduce PDF size with QPDF lossless stream optimization or configurable image downsampling.
- [Edit PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/edit): Add custom text overlays across PDF pages with undo support.
- [Fill PDF Forms](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/fill-form): Complete interactive AcroForm fields, checkboxes, radio groups, and dropdowns locally.
- [Sign PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/sign): Draw, type, date-stamp, or upload signatures across single or multiple pages.
- [Watermark PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/watermark): Stamp text or image watermarks including diagonal tiling and batch ZIP export.
- [Page Numbers](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/page-numbers): Insert customizable page numbering across PDFs.
- [Bates Numbering](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/bates-numbering): Apply continuous legal Bates prefixes, zero-padded IDs, and custom headers/footers.
- [Grayscale PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/grayscale): Convert color PDFs to monochrome BT.709 grayscale for printing.
- [Flatten PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/flatten): Convert interactive form fields and annotations into static page content via pdf-lib and QPDF WASM.

### Privacy, Security & Verification
- [Protect PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/protect): Encrypt PDFs locally with 256-bit AES user/owner passwords and granular permissions via QPDF WebAssembly.
- [Unlock PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/unlock): Decrypt password-protected PDFs or remove owner restrictions locally via QPDF WebAssembly.
- [Redact & Sanitize](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/redact): Permanently rasterize/black out sensitive regions and strip metadata.
- [Metadata Editor & Scrubber](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/metadata): Inspect, edit, or strip Title, Author, Subject, Creator, Producer, and timestamps.
- [Compare PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/compare): Side-by-side pixel and line-level text diff with downloadable HTML diff reports.

### AI & OCR
- [AI PDF Summarizer & Chat](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/ai-chat): Local TF-IDF extractive QA, auto-OCR fallback for scans, category & topic detection, Markdown/PDF export, plus opt-in On-Device Browser LLM (`LanguageModel` / WebGPU synthesis).
- [OCR PDF](https://www.uselocalpdf.com/tools/ocr): Optical character recognition powered by self-hosted Tesseract.js v7 with searchable invisible-text PDF export.
